single active hosted-checkout PaymentAttempt enforced by PostgreSQL, deterministic Order-first locks, 90-second leases, persistent sanitized retry control, and per-event failure isolation
manager-tier idempotent creation, checkout request, verified cancellation, explicit reopen/provider switch, reconciliation, and Order cancellation coordination

ORM and PostgreSQL-protected immutable financial snapshots plus sanitized status/webhook evidence and closed AuditEvent/OutboxEvent schemas

manager-only external evidence, OPERATOR masked visibility with active hosted-link access, server-rendered HTML, manager-tier tenant-scoped read-only admin, executable provider-network blocking, tasks, documentation, and clone continuity

organization_isolation.evidence: Organization-explicit services/selectors/workers, active Membership policies before provider I/O, Order-PaymentIntent-PaymentAttempt lock order, same-Organization provider-account/resource resolution, callback organization derived from its route account, manager-tier tenant-scoped admin, and direct cross-tenant/cross-account/concurrency tests.

provider_contracts.mercado_pago: Checkout Pro request builder matches a versioned official-contract fixture; signed callback validation, authenticated replay key, authoritative-resource injection, deduplication, rate controls, and disabled network effects passed direct tests.
provider_contracts.pagarme: Payment Links v5 builder uses required payment_settings and cart_settings from a versioned official OpenAPI fixture; callback remains disabled by design.
provider_contracts.network_blocking_evidence: Autouse Payments fixture rejects DNS resolution for known Mercado Pago and Pagar.me provider hosts; direct test passed.

public API, importers, inventory, fiscal, Dashboard, Coolify, homologation, cutover, and later phases
